_all: Notes for translators of ui.en.json. Keep every {placeholder} exactly (same names, any order). Keys ending _kid are the simple wording shown at reading levels 1 and 2: keep them as simple as the English. Keys ending _one / _other are plural forms chosen by the number {n} (or the number in the note); languages with more forms (Russian) may add _few and _many with the same placeholders. Short UI labels (buttons, chips, tags, column heads) should stay about as short as the English: the page must fit a 360px phone screen.
doc_title: Browser tab title and PDF title. The product name; keep 'BC Vote Helper' in Latin letters or translate the generic words only.
mast_title: Product name in the page header, next to the year 2026.
reset_all: Button in the header, toolbar, footer and dialog. Max about 24 characters.
noscript: Shown only when JavaScript is off.
foot_text: {date} is a full date, already in the page language, e.g. October 12, 2026.
lang_label: Screen-reader label of the language picker. The page appends ' (Language)' in English after it.
ai_notice: One line under the header on every translated page. Keep it one or two short sentences.
ai_notice_switch: Link button after the notice that switches the page to English. Max about 22 characters.
cd_days_one: Countdown fragment, e.g. '1 day'. Used inside cd_before_advance, cd_advance_open and cd_advance_closed.
cd_before_advance: Header countdown. {adv} and {day} are cd_days phrases, e.g. '4 days to advance voting, 12 days to voting day'.
cd_today: Polls are open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Pacific time; a 24-hour clock is fine.
person_n: Default name for person {n} (1 to 4) when no name was typed. Short.
logo_alt: Alt text of a party logo image. {party} is the party's short name.
level_long: Reading level for screen readers: {label} is the level name (e.g. Plain language), {experience} who it suits (e.g. follow the news a bit).
local_tag: Small tag on a local (regional) question when no region name is known.
colon: Label and value, e.g. 'Dad: not sure or skipped'. Use your language's colon spacing.
name_party: Candidate name with their party in brackets, e.g. 'Jane Doe (BC NDP)'.
and_word: The word 'and' between two party chips when a person has a close result. One word.
local_note_ridings_one: {riding} is a riding (electoral district) name, {region} a region name, {n} the number of ridings in that region (always 2 or more).
local_note_result_one: {winner} is the 2024 winner's name, {party} a party short name, {votes} the vote margin (formatted number), {points} the margin in percentage points.
riding_alts: {ridings} is a list of riding names shown as buttons, separated by commas.
riding_meta: Line under the chosen riding: {region}. {candidates}. {local}. Each part is its own key (cand_count..., riding_meta_local...). Keep the three parts in this order.
cand_count_scored_one: {n} scored candidates; {more} is the number of other candidates listed but not scored.
riding_choose: First option of the riding list.
pc_empty: V3S 1A1 is an example postal code; keep it as is.
count_just_me: Under the big number 1 in the 'how many people' picker. Max about 10 characters.
count_people_one: Under the big numbers 2, 3 and 4 in the 'how many people' picker. Max about 10 characters.
start_with: Start button. {name} is the first person's name or 'Person 1'.
your_pick: Small uppercase label under the answer a person has chosen. Max about 12 characters.
quiz_skip_opt: Last answer option on every question.
skip: Button and small radio label. Max about 8 characters.
quiz_done_pass: Button on the last question when another person answers next. Max about 20 characters.
tg_skip_kid: Small radio label beside the letters A, B, C. Max about 10 characters.
tg_imp_short: Very short label before Low / Medium / High in the group screen. One word.
tg_imp_short_kid: Very short label before A little / Some / A lot. One word.
imp_low_kid: Importance button for young readers. Max about 10 characters.
scored_note: Small note under a party's score bar, lower case start: the party had no published position on some answers.
hl_scored: Same idea as scored_note, as full sentences under the big result.
party_incumbent: {party} is a party short name; the candidate is the current MLA.
party_incumbent_mla: {party} is a party short name (or 'Independent'); the candidate is the current MLA.
fam_col_all: Column head over family scores (all members). Max about 6 characters.
fam_col_adults: Column head: members at reading levels 3 to 5. Max about 6 characters; 'L3-5' style abbreviations are fine.
hl_close_1: Label on a result card when several parties are within 3 points: 1st place. hl_close_2 to hl_close_5 are 2nd to 5th.
hl_next: {name} is the runner-up party or candidate, {pct} a whole number (the % sign follows).
hl_match: Small uppercase word under the big percentage, e.g. '54% match'. Max about 10 characters.
close_banner: {names} is a list of parties or candidates (already joined with 'and'), {points} is 3.
who_same: Family results: number of questions where everyone gave the same answer.
chip_closest: {parties} is one or more party short names separated by ' / '.
pips_aria: Screen reader: a closeness score {n} out of 4.
no_position_list: {parties} is a comma list of party short names.
agree_sum_wrap: Wraps the summary phrases (agree_sum_agree, agree_sum_close, ...) joined with commas, e.g. 'same answer on 3 questions, split on 2 questions.' The first letter is capitalised by the page. This is the one place phrases are joined, so each agree_sum phrase must read correctly on its own.
local_weight_one: {count} is the number of local questions (as a word in English, digits in other languages), {region} a region name.
cand_note_one: {count} is the number of local questions (as a word in English, digits in other languages).
cand_lead_inc: {riding} is the riding name, {name} the incumbent MLA. 105 recorded divisions is a fact; keep the number.
cands_we_score_one: {count} is the number of scored candidates (a word in English, digits elsewhere).
since_2024: Bold label before a sentence about MLA changes since 2024.
where_communities: {communities} is the list of communities in the riding (already translated); keep the full stop style of your language.
party_meta: {leader} is the leader's name, {candidates} and {seats} are numbers.
privacy_local: The quoted words must match your translation of reset_all.
fam_skipped_one: {names} is the name(s) of people who skipped every question.
res_title_named: {name} is the person's name; {party} a party short name. In English the possessive becomes Chris' when the name ends in s.
res_eyebrow: {place} is the riding name or 'All of BC'; {date} is a full date.
who_province: {who} is 'Your result' or 'Family average of 3 people'.
who_riding: {who} as in who_province, {riding} the riding name.
fam_key_all_one: {all} is the bold column label (fam_col_all); {n} the number of people.
fam_key_adults_one: {adults} is the bold column label (fam_col_adults); {n} the number of people.
adults_top: {match} is a bold party or candidate name with its percentage.
drv_line: {a} and {b} are numbers with one decimal; {top} and {second} party short names.
drv_intro: {top} and {second} are party short names. In English {top}'s becomes NDP's or Greens'.
ranked_title: {count} is the number of parties (a word in English, digits elsewhere).
text_meta: Plain-text copy of the results. {today} and {date} are full dates.
text_imp_low: Plain-text tag after an answer with low importance.
text_drv_line: {lead} is a number with one decimal.
pdf_col_all: PDF column head; English uses capitals. Short.
pdf_col_adults: PDF column head; English uses capitals.
pdf_col_person: PDF column head; English uses capitals. Short.
pdf_close_mark: PDF table cell: {pct} is a percentage like 54%; '(close)' marks a near tie for first.
pdf_top_mark: PDF table cell: {pct} is a percentage like 54%; '(top)' marks the person's closest party.
pdf_participant_item: {name} person's name, {level} reading level with who it suits, {n} answered of {total}.
pdf_footer: Footer on every PDF page; keep it to about three short lines.
